content.jointProblem: Can a combined Serbian morphological normalisation/lemmatisation and automatic script-canonicalisation layer, integrated into LinguaBot's Elasticsearch pipeline, reduce the measured 18% no-useful-result rate while allowing new client vocabulary to be added without a full re-index? The first experiment would test whether the researcher's phoneme-canonical and stem-after-normalisation methods transfer from news/legal corpora to the company's 85,000 labelled support query-response pairs and the 12,000-query miss sample.

rationale.text: He leads a group working directly on retrieval in mixed Cyrillic-Latin Serbian documents, script normalization, transliteration preprocessing and script-robust inverted indexes.

sources.quote: Njegova istraživačka grupa bavi se pronalaženjem informacija u dokumentima koji sadrže mešovito ćirilično-latinično srpsko pismo, normalizacijom skripte, transliteracijom kao korakom u pretprocesiranju i izgradnjom invertovanih indeksa otpornih na varijacije pisma.

rationale.text: His published methodology builds an inverted index for mixed-script Serbian by generating a phoneme-based canonical token form as the primary index identifier, evaluated on 120,000 news articles with F1 0.81.

sources.quote: Predloženi postupak uključuje korak normalizacije tokena kojim se za svaki token generiše kanonska forma zasnovana na fonemskoj reprezentaciji, a zatim se fonemski ključevi koriste kao primarni identifikatori u indeksu.
Predloženi sistem postiže F1 vrednost od 0,81 u zadatku ad-hoc pretrage, što je povećanje od 14 procentnih poena u odnosu na bolji od dva bazična sistema.

rationale.text: His work explicitly studies the interaction of stemming/lemmatisation with script normalization and finds stemming after normalization consistently better, which maps to the company's morphological-mismatch problem.

sources.quote: pri čemu stemovanje posle normalizacije daje konzistentno bolje rezultate za sve tri kombinacije

rationale.text: He has cross-script query-expansion evidence with named-entity expansion reducing index bloat while keeping retrieval latency low.

sources.quote: Strategy 3 achieved the best mean average precision of 0.497, versus 0.431 for no expansion, while reducing index bloat to 6% over the baseline index size.

rationale.text: He has industry contract experience adapting a search module for Serbian court decisions over 18 months.

sources.quote: U periodu 2022–2023. sarađivao je s jednim novosadskim startapom iz oblasti legaltech-a na prilagođavanju pretražnog modula za srpske sudske odluke, u okviru ugovornog istraživanja trajanja 18 meseci.

rationale.text: He reports capacity for one smaller industrial contract or consulting engagement.

sources.quote: Trenutno je angažovan na dva aktivna projekta, ali ima kapaciteta za jedan manji industrijski ugovor ili konsultantski angažman.

risks: Formal availability is unknown; the notes only state capacity for one smaller industrial contract or consulting engagement, so scheduling must be confirmed.

The core evidence comes from news, legal, encyclopedia-style and web corpora, while the company's support queries include mid-word script typos; transfer to this query distribution is untested and must be a first experiment.
Maintenance may fail if new client terminology requires manual dictionary updates; both the company's synonym-list experience and the researcher's pilot limitation point to this.
A neural normalizer can add latency at production percentiles, so any neural component should be limited to out-of-vocabulary fallback unless SLOs allow otherwise.
The researcher's stemming evidence was evaluated on a CLEF 2012 subset, not on the company's bank support queries, so morphological gains may not transfer directly.
The modest budget and six-month window may limit data annotation and tooling scope, especially if the company's 85,000-pair dataset needs re-labelling for the target metric.
questions: Can you confirm your availability for a six-month joint project within the company's modest budget, given the note that you have capacity for one smaller industrial contract or consulting engagement?
Will LinguaBot provide access to the 85,000 labelled query-response pairs and the 12,000-query sample, and will the two in-house linguists be available for annotation and validation?
What is the exact definition and per-client breakdown of 'no useful result', and how should the below-5% target be measured?
Which Elasticsearch version and indexing/query pipeline must the solution fit, and what re-indexing or downtime is allowed when new vocabulary arrives?
What latency and throughput SLOs apply to production search, and can a neural fallback be limited to out-of-vocabulary tokens?
How should new product terminology be maintained operationally, and who owns updates to override rules and synonym lists after the project?
Can you share examples of mid-word script mixing and the current Croatian stemmer's failure cases for the first experiment?
